## Overview

## Key Vocabulary


::: {.vocab-box}
**Sequence alignment** — Comparing DNA or protein sequences to find similarities
:::

::: {.vocab-box}
**Database search** — Looking through large collections of sequences to find matches
:::

::: {.vocab-box}
**Homology** — Similarity between sequences suggesting a common ancestor
:::

::: {.vocab-box}
**BLAST** — A tool for searching biological databases
:::

::: {.vocab-box}
**Annotation** — Adding information and labels to genetic sequences
:::

::: {.vocab-box}
**Phylogenetics** — Using genetic data to determine evolutionary relationships
:::
